purpose: Describe carrying an action all the way to completion.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
I finished reading the long novel.
I ran all the way to the finish.
I used up this month’s budget.
restrictions: Often emphasizes exhaustion, determination, or consuming the full amount.
mistake: This suffix is not interchangeable with physical 切る meaning cut.
